text:
mei: thinking about a focused 'safety lane' for autofallbacks — small surface in Rollouts for operator triage + audit. low noise, high signal.

hugo: quick Q: safety lane vs quarantine vs triage? name aside, what specifically is different?

mei: safety lane = purpose-built for policy-triggered fallbacks (degrades). it shows only samples that changed routing decision automatically, with minimal fields: trigger, route, variant, redacted snippet, score.

shera: we need clear error triggers: `latency>t`, `model_exception`, `kv_cache_miss`, `quota_exhausted`. reason tags should be normalized.

mei: agreed. also surface the active fallback mode (soft / hard / degrade-to-cache) and whether it's auto or operator-invoked.

ops-bot: notice: enabling sampling on route /api/reply at 0.2% -> est 3.6GB/month compressed.

hugo: privacy: default to masked payloads. de-redact must be explicit + create audit entry with operator id and justification. store full payload only in encrypted audit store with restricted ACL.

shera: UX: compact list view, cluster similar hits, show a confidence score for the trigger classifier, and a tiny sparkline showing trigger frequency. clicking opens decision trace.

mei: config idea (console + API):
```autofallback:
  enabled: true
  mode: "graceful"
  sample_rate: 0.002
  reasons: ["latency","model_exception"]
  safety_lane: true
  retention_days: 14
```

hugo: operator actions: dismiss, escalate (create issue), propose-fix (creates a draft rollout patch), pin-for-rollback. all actions = audit events.

shera: propose-fix should include a simulation preview: estimated p95, cost delta, and estimated success rate (based on past traces). show inline before apply.

mei: to limit noise: caps per-route + adaptive backoff: if triggers/sec > threshold, reduce sampling prob with exponential decay. show an "estimated miss rate" label.

hugo: clustering: use simple ngram similarity + time window. group representative + count, allow bulk-actions on cluster.

ops-bot: policy: retention tiers: default 7d, enterprise optional 90d with signed SLA. de-redact events are logged to audit stream.

shera: telemetry: emit metrics `safetylane.samples`, `safetylane.clusters`, `safetylane.operator_actions`, `safetylane.de_redacts`. connect to Rollouts dashboard.

mei: API endpoints needed: GET /rollouts/{id}/safety-lane?cluster=&filter= POST /rollouts/{id}/safety-lane/{sample}/action POST /rollouts/{id}/safety-lane/bulk_action

hugo: RBAC: `safety.view`, `safety.annotate`, `safety.apply`, `safety.de_redact` (last one requires two-person approval for enterprise).

shera: small felt UX tweak: show a tiny banner when safety lane is on: "Sampling enabled — we capture a small % of autofallback hits for review. Data is masked by default." with a link to privacy docs.

mei: edge-case: routes behind high-throughput proxies. enforce hard cap + reservoir sampling so db writes don't spike. runtime will expose `estimated_ingest_rate`.

hugo: runtime spike plan: simulate 5k rps, 0.1% sampling, run for 1h, measure p99 latency impact and DB ingest. I'll do it tomorrow. :coffee:

ops-bot: reminder: turning on safety_lane will schedule a lightweight migration creating `safety_samples` table; expect short lock window.

mei: next steps: I'll draft a one-pager + console copy; hugo to run spike; shera to write privacy wording + de-redact flow. target: prototype in 1 sprint.

hugo: ack. starting spike tomorrow.

mei: thanks — keep defaults conservative. :thumbsup:
